about: Figures quoted in the README, each with the official page it was read from and a verbatim quote. Checked by scripts/verify-sources.mjs like every other sourced fact.

statistics.statement: In 2025 the FBI's Internet Crime Complaint Center received 201,266 complaints from people aged 60 and over.
statistics.title: 2025 IC3 Annual Report: IC3 Elder Fraud, complaints filed by individuals 60+

statistics.statement: Those complaints reported $7.748 billion in losses, 59% more than in 2024.
statistics.title: 2025 IC3 Annual Report: IC3 Elder Fraud, complaints filed by individuals 60+

statistics.statement: The average loss was $38,500, and 12,444 people aged 60 and over lost more than $100,000.
statistics.title: 2025 IC3 Annual Report: IC3 Elder Fraud, complaints filed by individuals 60+

statistics.statement: Cryptocurrency ATMs and kiosks accounted for 13,460 complaints and $389 million in losses across all ages in 2025.
statistics.title: 2025 IC3 Annual Report: Cryptocurrency ATMs/Kiosks

statistics.statement: The Consumer Financial Protection Bureau advises older adults that choosing a trusted contact person can help protect their money.
statistics.title: Protecting against fraud: resources for older adults
statistics.quote: Choosing a trusted contact person can help you protect your money

statistics.statement: The FTC's advice for avoiding a scam includes stopping to talk to someone you trust before doing anything else.
statistics.title: How To Avoid a Scam
statistics.quote: Stop and talk to someone you trust.
